name: EH3D-VISION-STUDIO
notes: Scaffolding v0.0.2: a library and a command line that find round fiducial marks in a PNG or PGM image (Otsu threshold, connected spots, size, fill and elongation checks, marks cut by the edge refused), turn pixels into millimetres with the scale of a mark of known size, fit and correct the radial distortion of a lens from a grid of marks, and work out the turn, the shift and (if allowed) the size that take a board from its design to where the camera found it. No live camera, no neural network and no Hailo acceleration yet; nothing has looked at a real board.
